data.transcriptHtml: Hi, Ms. Baxter. This is Peter Peterson from the Century Science Museum. Author: Justin Marshall

Reviewed by: Christine Petrelli

As the title of the book suggests, readers can expect financial solutions that work for anyone and in any situation. However, after reviewing the book, it is clear that the author in fact talks about his personal financial success rather than case by case solutions. In other words, the purpose of this book is not to provide readers with true financial advice but to admire his own financial prosperity through a series of very fortunate financial opportunites and not a strategic approach to financial problems. Dear Applicants,
Thank you for applying to JNH. We wish you luck with your interview. This letter is to provide you information and instructions regarding the interview. As you noticed from the application form, all our applicants are required to give a 20-minute interview with three executives at JNH.
Applicants will be evaluated 20% based on their resume and previous work experience and 80% based on the interview. Thus, the interview is the most important part of the application process.
Interviews will take place on May 4th from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, with an hour for lunch between noon and 1:00 PM. Interviewers will ask applicants about their opinions on the direction that the company should be heading in the future and other challenging economic problems. You'll also have time to introduce yourself to the interviewers. However, please note that the more time you take to introduce yourself, the less time you'll have to answer questions from the interviewers.
We will announce who has been hired two weeks after the interview. This will be done by mail. The letter will be delivered to your home address by express delivery so that you'll be able to hear from us as soon as possible. Once you hear from us, you'll be asked to write back to us within five days. All the necessary paper work will be enclosed in the envelope. All you have to do is fill out the paper work and send it back to us. Once the documents are received, we'll notify you of your first day at JNH.
We wish you all the best and also remind you to be on time on the interview day. Thank you again for applying to JNH and see you soon at the interview.

Sincerely,
Chris Foster
Chief Executive of JNH

You might think that “Room type” could also be a correct answer. However, consider the following statements:

“I wasn't informed of the rate of the suite compared to a room with a queen-sized bed.”

=> This means that the customer was not informed of the price difference between a suite and a room with a queen-sized bed.

“I'm afraid that I will have to switch back to the room with the queen-sized bed.”

=> The customer wants to switch back to his original room type because the suite may exceed his company's accommodation budget.

=> The important point is that the customer does not explicitly state that he never requested an upgrade. He only says that he was not informed of the price before the change was made. Therefore, we cannot definitively conclude that the hotel changed the room type without his request.

=> Correct Answer: B. Date of stay.

“I told the person in charge that I will postpone my reservation exactly two weeks, but I guess he must have misheard what I said.”

  • Original date: December 10th.

  • The customer wants to postpone the reservation by exactly two weeks: December 24th.

  • However, the hotel confirms the reservation for December 17th.

=> This is a mistake caused by the staff member misunderstanding the customer's request. Therefore, the date of stay was definitely changed incorrectly.

You might think that “Room type” could also be a correct answer. However, consider the following statements:

“I wasn't informed of the rate of the suite compared to a room with a queen-sized bed.”

=> This means that the customer was not informed of the price difference between a suite and a room with a queen-sized bed.

“I'm afraid that I will have to switch back to the room with the queen-sized bed.”

=> The customer wants to switch back to his original room type because the suite may exceed his company's accommodation budget.

=> The important point is that the customer does not explicitly state that he never requested an upgrade. He only says that he was not informed of the price before the change was made. Therefore, we cannot definitively conclude that the hotel changed the room type without his request.

=> Correct Answer: B. Date of stay.

  • precludes = ngăn ngừa trước, làm cho không thể xảy ra
  • accommodates = cung cấp chỗ cho, thích nghi với

→ Đáp án đúng là: precipitates
